channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: South Korea’s President Urges Trump-Kim Talks to End Stalemate
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung called for a swift resumption of talks between the US and North Korea, seeking to capitalize on Donald Trump’s relationship with Kim Jong Un to end a decades-long stalemate on the peninsula.
item.dc:creator: Heesu Lee

item.title: Japan PM Takaichi Urges UN Security Council Reform
item.description: In her maiden speech to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi called for urgent structural reforms to the Security Council. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump’s Grip on GOP Slips as Midterm Election Anxiety Sets In
item.description: As Donald Trump took an aggressive stance on the global stage at the United Nations on Tuesday, several Senate Republicans were breaking from the president back in Washington.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis and Erik Wasson

item.title: Burnham Warns UN That AI Can Enhance Russian Disinformation
item.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Tuesday evening accused Russia of spreading lies and disinformation in what he said was an “attack” on society as he revealed plans for a new disinformation center at the heart of his government.
item.dc:creator: Chloe Chaplain

item.title: EU Tells Ukraine to Bolster Rule of Law Before It Gets More Aid
item.description: European Union officials have told Ukraine they need to see progress on new legislation to curb the shadow economy, bolster tax revenue and move closer to EU law before they’ll dispense more funding.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Palasciano

item.title: AI in Focus Ahead of Trump-Xi Meeting
item.description: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY) says China is “in some ways an ally, in some ways an adversary” as the US and China compete over artificial intelligence. Rep. Malliotakis says talks with Beijing over an AI framework are worthwhile, but questions whether China can be trusted to follow one. Anna Ashton, Co-Founder of Ashton Intelligence, says extending the US-China trade truce will likely be a central issue when President Trump meets Chinese President Xi Jinping. Ashton says the length of any extension matters as China retains leverage through restrictions on rare-earth exports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bessent Disclosures Show Assets Worth at Least $228 Million
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent earned at least $5.1 million from assets worth at least $228 million in 2025, according to newly released financial disclosures covering his first year in public office.
item.dc:creator: Bill Allison

item.title: Ashton: Trade Truce Will Be Key Test of Trump-Xi Talks
item.description: Anna Ashton, Co-Founder of Ashton Intelligence, says extending the US-China trade truce will likely be a central issue when President Trump meets Chinese President Xi Jinping. Ashton says the length of any extension matters as China retains leverage through restrictions on rare-earth exports. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rep. Malliotakis Says China Is ‘An Ally, an Adversary’
item.description: Rep. Nicole Malliotakis (R-NY) says China is “in some ways an ally, in some ways an adversary” as the US and China compete over artificial intelligence. Rep. Malliotakis says talks with Beijing over an AI framework are worthwhile, but questions whether China can be trusted to follow one. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI & Chip Stocks Lead Markets Higher
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are DWS Group Global CEO Stefan Hoops, Guggenheim Senior Managing Director Michael Morris, Whole Foods Market CEO Jason Buechel, Aldi U.S. Chief Operating Officer Dave Rinaldo, Partners Group Chief Investment Strategist Anastasia Amoroso, CVC Marathon Head & Managing Partner Bruce Richards, Qualcomm CFO & COO Akash Palkhiwala, Qantas CEO Vanessa Hudson, Finland President Alex Stubb, & UN Foundation President & CEO Elizabeth Cousens. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Pageantry for Xi Will Mask Feud Over US-China AI Race
item.description: Donald Trump welcomes Xi Jinping to Washington for a state visit focused more on pageantry than policy, with low expectations for breakthroughs on long-standing feuds between the world’s biggest economies.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove, Nectar Gan and Hadriana Lowenkron

item.title: Xi Unlikely to Bring CEOs to Summit Where Trump Is Seeking Deals
item.description: The highly anticipated summit between President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping will bring together a robust gathering of US corporate leaders, but there will not be a comparable delegation of Chinese executives, raising questions about the prospects for the world’s two largest economies to strike new business deals this week.
item.dc:creator: Hadriana Lowenkron, Kate O'Keeffe, Michelle Jamrisko and Nectar Gan

item.title: If Poland Gets a US Base It’ll Be Called Fort Trump, Nawrocki Says
item.description: President Karol Nawrocki said he hopes the US will finalize plans to establish a permanent military base in Poland and, if it does, the compound will be christened ‘Fort Trump.’
item.dc:creator: Francine Lacqua and Zosia Wanat

item.title: Trump’s ‘Lavish Welcome’ for Xi Slammed by Key GOP Senator
item.description: Senate Armed Services Chairman Roger Wicker sharply criticized Donald Trump for the manner in which he plans to host Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington this week, marking a significant public break from a key member of the president’s own party just ahead of the high-stakes summit.
item.dc:creator: Erik Wasson

item.title: Trump Is Setting The UN Up To Fail
item.description: This year’s UN General Assembly in New York is consumed not only by the world’s multiplying conflicts but also by the search for a new secretary general, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andreas Kluth says. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump, Burnham Discussed Bringing Up Jimmy Lai With China’s Xi
item.description: President Donald Trump and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham discussed bringing up the detention of Hong Kong tycoon and democracy activist Jimmy Lai when the US leader meets China’s Xi Jinping later this week.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Chloe Chaplain

item.title: British Columbia Leader Eby Calls Snap Election to Cement Power Amid US Tariffs
item.description: British Columbia Premier David Eby called an early election in a bid to consolidate control over the west coast province, capitalizing on his opponents’ disarray and arguing for a fresh mandate amid Canada’s worsening trade war with the US.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Seal

item.title: Takaichi Urges UN to Cut Japan’s 1940s-Era ‘Enemy State’ Tag
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urged the United Nations to remove references to Japan and Germany as “enemy states,” a classification China has recently seized on to criticize Tokyo after a breakdown in ties over Taiwan.
item.dc:creator: Alastair Gale

item.title: Trump Hails ‘Very Good’ Iran Talks Following Annihilation Threat
item.description: President Donald Trump said US officials had “very good” talks with Iranian envoys in New York, reviving fragile hopes for a new diplomatic off-ramp hours after he again threatened to annihilate the country.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove and Jennifer A. Dlouhy

item.title: Republican Senator Calls for Investigation Into Trump Family
item.description: A Republican senator is calling for an investigation into the Trump family’s financial dealings — including demanding testimony from Donald Trump Jr. — in a sharp break with the president weeks before the midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Steven T. Dennis
